commands:
mkdir -p .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1304/cloud
gh pr diff 1304 | awk '/^diff --git/{in_logs=/ [ab]\/\.prflow\/logs\//} !in_logs' | tee .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1304/cloud/diff.patch | tail -1; echo "diff-rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"

for f in cite-ac cite-marked cite-unmarked cite-pr-unmarked cite-hex-clean cite-two-on-one-line cite-fence-unmarked cite-fence-shell-marked cite-fence-html-marked cite-ac-boundary-clean; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat "lib/test/fixtures/shipped-pruned-path/skills/$f.md"; echo; done

for f in cite-ac cite-marked cite-unmarked cite-pr-unmarked cite-hex-clean cite-two-on-one-line cite-fence-unmarked cite-fence-shell-marked cite-fence-html-marked cite-ac-boundary-clean; do echo "=== $f.md ==="; git show "3ab880c73:lib/test/fixtures/shipped-pruned-path/skills/$f.md"; done

cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow || exit; for f in cite-ac cite-marked cite-unmarked cite-pr-unmarked cite-hex-clean cite-two-on-one-line cite-fence-unmarked cite-fence-shell-marked cite-fence-html-marked cite-ac-boundary-clean; do printf '=== %s.md ===\n' "$f"; git show "3ab880c73:lib/test/fixtures/shipped-pruned-path/skills/$f.md"; done

cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow || exit
git diff 67288992c..3ab880c73 -- 'skills/**' 'agents/**' > .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1304/cloud/prose.patch
grep -cE '^\-[^-]' .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1304/cloud/prose.patch
grep -cE '^\+[^+]' .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1304/cloud/prose.patch
echo "--- removed lines containing binding words ---"
grep -nE '^\-' .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1304/cloud/prose.patch | grep -iE 'non-negotiable|mandatory|\bmust\b|\bnever\b|\balways\b|\brequired\b' | head -60
git grep -nE '\bissue[s]? [0-9]{2,}|\bAC[- ][0-9]|\bPR [0-9]{2,}' 3ab880c73 -- skills | grep -vE 'issue-[0-9]|issue number|issue body|issue #' | head -40

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
